data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis 1/5): AC-9 must enforce exactly 5 distinct event-type sections. Extend AC-9 to assert (a) parser collects exactly 5 event-type ### sections matching the canonical set, (b) each event_type value inside the parsed JSON matches its ### heading, (c) set of event_type values across the 5 blocks is exactly the canonical 5 with no duplicates.
